param: π Human recruitment/birth rate (given in Table 3 snippet: annual birth rate expressed per day)
k Proportion of recruited humans vaccinated at entry (recruitment split πk to V_H and π(1-k) to S_H)
Λ Mosquito recruitment rate into susceptible mosquitoes S_M
μ₁ Natural death rate of humans (applies to human compartments)
μ₂ Natural death rate of mosquitoes (applies to mosquito compartments)
θ Waning of vaccine protection: transition from vaccinated humans V_H to susceptible humans S_H
γ Waning of natural immunity: transition from recovered humans R_H back to susceptible humans S_H
β₂ Mosquito-to-human transmission/contact rate (force of infection from infectious mosquitoes I_M to humans)
ε Vaccine breakthrough susceptibility modifier (vaccinated infection uses β₂·ε)
β₃ Human-to-mosquito transmission/contact rate (force of infection from infectious humans I_H to mosquitoes)
α₁ Allocation/transition rate from susceptible humans S_H into exposed humans class 1 (E_H1) upon infection (as shown in diagram)
α₂ Allocation/transition rate from susceptible humans S_H into exposed humans class 2 (E_H2) upon infection (as shown in diagram)
τ₁ Progression rate from exposed humans E_H1 to infectious humans I_H
τ₂ Progression rate from exposed humans E_H2 to infectious humans I_H
σ Treatment initiation rate: infectious humans I_H to treated humans T_H
ω Recovery rate under treatment: treated humans T_H to recovered humans R_H
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate for infectious and/or treated humans (diagram shows μ₁+δ₁ leaving I_H and T_H)
φ Progression/incubation rate in mosquitoes: exposed mosquitoes E_M to infectious mosquitoes I_M
β₂ε Effective mosquito-to-vaccinated-human transmission rate (breakthrough), β₂ multiplied by ε
